ABOUT THE INDEX

What’s in this collection?

This catalog helps you explore English-language freeCodeCamp News. Article links open the original website in a new tab. Full article text and images are not reproduced here.

Collection coverage

Topics and categories

Topics are freeCodeCamp’s primary topic labels from its public article listings. Articles may have additional tags that are not exposed by those listings.

Categories are our own automated groupings based on title, URL, and primary topic. An article may appear in several categories. These are browsing aids, not freeCodeCamp’s official taxonomy or an assessment of difficulty.

URL-only entries remain searchable by their address. They do not have verified titles, authors, publication dates, or topic labels. They are grouped from URL keywords only and appear after dated articles.

Typography

Lato connects the interface, titles, and reading text. The guide’s 18px/27px body text, 19.8px listing headings, and 14px metadata inform this layout. System sans-serif section headings use the study’s article treatment. Narrow-screen sizes are adaptations for this catalog, not measured freeCodeCamp mobile styles.
